```{r message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```



# Load SCE object

```{r}
sce <- HDF5Array::loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("datasets/GSE144136.h5se")
sce <- sce[1:1000,1:1000]
counts(sce) <- as.matrix(counts(sce))
```



# All-in-One

```{r}
source("lib_QC.R")
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
x <- transcriptomic_pipeline(sce,
        methods = c("multiseq","gmm_demux", "htodemux", "dropletutils"),
        output_dir = "qc_GSE144136",
        min_nfeatures = 1000)
```
